args.prompt:
One continuous 30-second take: a single unbroken camera move, no cuts, no jump cuts, no scene changes. Smooth gimbal, no shake. Cinematic 35mm film look, soft grain, warm studio light.
CAST: @Image1 is the opening composition and set: a dark film soundstage, a lit ivory SOL candle on a black plinth in the centre under a warm spotlight. @Image2 is the MAN (Otto): long pale face, heavy dark brows, swept-back hair with silver temples, an enormous charcoal-black handlebar moustache with spiral tips that completely covers his mouth, black turtleneck, charcoal blazer, oxblood pocket square, brass viewfinder on a chain. He always stands on the LEFT of the candle. His mouth is never visible; when he speaks, only his moustache and cheeks move. @Image3 is the WOMAN (Vee): platinum buzz cut, round vermilion-tinted spectacles, olive skin with freckles, oversized ivory double-breasted suit, vermilion scarf, silver stopwatch on a chain. She always stands on the RIGHT of the candle. They keep their exact faces, wardrobe and positions for the whole shot.
@Audio1 is the exact dialogue track, in order: the man's deep dry British voice and the woman's confident British voice. Lip-sync the woman's lines to her mouth; the man's lines move only his moustache.
FIRST FRAME: exactly @Image1.
RULES: real physics; one camera path; no new people; the candle flame flickers gently throughout.
[0-3 s] The camera is already moving: a slow push toward the trio. The man lowers his brass viewfinder from the candle and says to camera, deadpan: "This candle has never been filmed."
[3-5 s] The woman glances at him, half-smile, and says: "It has now."
[5-13 s] Without cutting, the camera drifts slightly right toward her as she speaks to camera, crisp and confident: "We're VXO. Product films made with AI. Thirty seconds, one take, no cuts."
[13-18 s] The camera drifts back left toward the man; he raises one brow and says: "No crew. No studio. Just taste." He frames the candle with his viewfinder.
[18-23 s] The camera settles centred on both; the woman holds up her stopwatch and says: "Send us one product photo. We send back five frames, free."
[23-26 s] The man nods once and says: "Then we roll."
[26-30 s] The woman clicks her stopwatch, looks into the lens and says: "Link in bio." The camera holds on both of them, the candle glowing between them.
AUDIO: their dialogue only, quiet studio room tone; no music.
No text overlays, no subtitles, no logos besides SOL, not a cartoon.
